tools.name: search_builders
tools.description: Search the Compare Auckland Builds directory of Auckland new-build and renovation builders (about 300 listings, each checked against its own website and public registers). Filter by suburb, project type, credential, register status and minimum rating. Returns organic results plus, always first and c

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Same as search_builders, but the default is ANY trade on a new build or renovation (builders, plumbers, electricians, landscapers, architects ... see list_trades). Pass trade to narrow to one. Sponsored (featured) listings come first for the trade searched, labelled, and cannot be filtered away. Tra

tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: The 42 trades involved in New Builds and Renovations in three groups (Building trades, Siteworks trades, Professional services), each with a plain-English description, the NZ licensing or registration body to check, the page URL and the number of directory listings. No credits.

tools.name: get_builder
tools.description: Full public profile for one directory listing (any trade): where they work, project types, credentials, register details, rating, status badge with date, published contact details, and provenance (source and date checked). Pass a slug (from search_builders) or the builder's name. detail=full costs 2

tools.name: list_suburbs
tools.description: Auckland suburbs and areas covered by the directory, with region and profile page link. No credits.

tools.name: list_project_types
tools.description: Project types used by the directory (new builds, kitchens, bathrooms ...) with the number of listings for each, plus the most common credentials. No credits.

tools.name: get_open_leads
tools.description: Recent public job leads in Auckland (from third-party marketplaces) that builders can respond to, by suburb and/or trade. Links go to the original posting; no personal details are included. 1 credit per lead for paid keys; free use max 5 per call.

tools.name: compare_builders
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 20 listings of any trade (slugs or names; the trade is shown for each): status badge, base, project types, credentials, rating, register details. Paid keys: 2 credits per builder with the richer fields; free use gets the summary comparison.

tools.name: builder_checks
tools.description: Neutral lookup of sourced public records (LBP Board disciplinary decisions, Gazette liquidation notices, Official Assignee notices, MBIE prosecutions) the website has collected. With no query: an overview with counts, dates checked and sources. With a query (name or company): name matches only, each

tools.name: how_to_get_quotes
tools.description: Links and a short checklist for getting and comparing quotes: the website's project brief and shortlist tools. Contains no personal data and this server never receives a user's name, phone or email. Optionally pass a suburb to include its page and any Sponsored featured builders there.

tools.name: my_usage
tools.description: Shows how many free calls are left this hour/day, or for a paid key the credit balance, expiry dates and recent usage. No credits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_trades, how_to_get_quotes · Private data: search_builders, get_builder, list_project_types, compare_builders, builder_checks · Public sink: how_to_get_quotes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_trades, how_to_get_quotes · Private data: search_builders, get_builder, list_project_types, compare_builders, builder_checks · Public sink: how_to_get_quotes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
